parameters.query:
WITH cleanup_exp AS (
      UPDATE appointments 
      SET status = 'EXPIRED', updated_at = NOW() 
      WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND expires_at <= NOW()
    ),
    cleanup_msg AS (
      DELETE FROM processed_messages 
      WHERE processed_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
    ),
    doc_list AS (
      SELECT json_agg(d.*) AS active_doctors
      FROM doctors d
      WHERE d.is_active = TRUE
    ),
    cust_appts AS (
      SELECT json_agg(a.* ORDER BY a.start_time DESC) AS recent_appointments
      FROM appointments a
      WHERE a.phone = $1 AND a.status IN ('PENDING', 'CONFIRMED', 'RESCHEDULED', 'ARRIVED')
    ),
    unavail_list AS (
      SELECT json_agg(u.*) AS active_unavailability
      FROM doctor_unavailability u
      WHERE u.end_time > NOW()
    ),
    rate_limit AS (
      SELECT COUNT(*) AS recent_msg_count
      FROM processed_messages
      WHERE sender = $1 AND processed_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 minute'
    )
    SELECT 
      COALESCE((SELECT active_doctors FROM doc_list), '[]'::json) AS active_doctors,
      COALESCE((SELECT recent_appointments FROM cust_appts), '[]'::json) AS recent_appointments,
      COALESCE((SELECT active_unavailability FROM unavail_list), '[]'::json) AS active_unavailability,
      COALESCE((SELECT recent_msg_count FROM rate_limit), 0) AS recent_msg_count;

WITH cleanup AS (
      UPDATE appointments 
      SET status = 'EXPIRED', updated_at = NOW() 
      WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND expires_at <= NOW()
    )
    INSERT INTO appointments (customer_name, phone, doctor_id, service, start_time, end_time, status, expires_at, created_at, updated_at)
    VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, 'PENDING', NOW() + INTERVAL '15 minutes', NOW(), NOW())
    RETURNING appointment_id, customer_name, phone, doctor_id, service, start_time, end_time, status, expires_at;
UPDATE appointments SET status = 'CANCELLED', updated_at = NOW() WHERE appointment_id = $1;

UPDATE appointments
    SET status = 'CONFIRMED',
        calendar_event_id = $1,
        updated_at = NOW(),
        reminder_3d_sent = FALSE,
        reminder_1d_sent = FALSE,
        reminder_4h_sent = FALSE,
        reminder_1h_sent = FALSE,
        reminder_3d_claimed_at = NULL,
        reminder_1d_claimed_at = NULL,
        reminder_4h_claimed_at = NULL,
        reminder_1h_claimed_at = NULL
    WHERE appointment_id = $2
      AND status = 'PENDING'
      AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > NOW())
    RETURNING appointment_id, customer_name, phone, doctor_id, service, start_time, end_time, status, calendar_event_id;

UPDATE appointments
    SET start_time = $1,
        end_time = $2,
        status = 'CONFIRMED',
        updated_at = NOW(),
        reminder_3d_sent = FALSE,
        reminder_1d_sent = FALSE,
        reminder_4h_sent = FALSE,
        reminder_1h_sent = FALSE,
        reminder_3d_claimed_at = NULL,
        reminder_1d_claimed_at = NULL,
        reminder_4h_claimed_at = NULL,
        reminder_1h_claimed_at = NULL
    WHERE appointment_id = $3
      AND phone = $4
      AND status = 'CONFIRMED'
    RETURNING *;

parameters.query:
UPDATE appointments
SET status = 'CANCELLED',
    updated_at = NOW(),
    reminder_3d_sent = TRUE,
    reminder_1d_sent = TRUE,
    reminder_4h_sent = TRUE,
    reminder_1h_sent = TRUE
WHERE appointment_id = $1
  AND phone = $2
  AND status IN ('PENDING', 'CONFIRMED', 'RESCHEDULED')
RETURNING *;

WITH ins AS (
  INSERT INTO processed_messages (message_id, channel, sender, processed_at)
  VALUES ($1, $5, $2, NOW())
  ON CONFLICT (message_id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING message_id
)
SELECT 
  $1 AS message_id,
  $2 AS phone,
  $3 AS customer_name,
  $4 AS message,
  $5 AS channel,
  $6 AS correlation_id,
  (CASE WHEN (SELECT message_id FROM ins) IS NOT NULL THEN true ELSE false END) AS is_new,
  (CASE WHEN (SELECT message_id FROM ins) IS NOT NULL THEN false ELSE true END) AS is_duplicate;
